# ─── Clerk Authentication ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# [OPTIONAL] Publishable key from https://dashboard.clerk.com → API Keys
# Leave blank (or any non-pk_ string) to run in dev-bypass mode (no auth wall).
# Set to a real pk_live_* or pk_test_* value to enable full Clerk authentication.
# Safe to expose — EXPO_PUBLIC_ prefix is intentional.
EXPO_PUBLIC_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY=

# ─── Client-side Supabase (safe to expose to Expo runtime) ───────────────────
# [REQUIRED] Your Supabase project URL — find it at https://app.supabase.com → Project Settings → API
EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL=https://your-project.supabase.co

# [REQUIRED] Supabase anon/public key — safe for client use, enforces Row Level Security
# Find it at https://app.supabase.com → Project Settings → API → anon public
EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=FILL_ME_IN

# ─── Secure API Proxy URL ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# [REQUIRED] URL of the Expo Router API route that proxies privileged server calls.
# Local development default — change to your deployed domain in staging/production.
# e.g. production: https://your-app.example.com/api/secure-proxy
EXPO_PUBLIC_SECURE_PROXY_URL=http://localhost:8081/api/secure-proxy

# ─── AI / Forecast API (optional external endpoint) ──────────────────────────
# [OPTIONAL] External AI forecast API URL.
# Leave blank to disable demand-forecasting features (hooks/useDemandForecast.ts
# gates on Boolean(EXPO_PUBLIC_FORECAST_API_URL)).
EXPO_PUBLIC_FORECAST_API_URL=

# ─── Temporary Identity Placeholders (pre-auth, Phase 4A) ────────────────────
# [OPTIONAL] Fallback account identifier used before Supabase Auth is wired up.
# Safe to pre-fill for local dev; replace with real Supabase Auth values in production.
EXPO_PUBLIC_ACCOUNT_ID=demo-account

# [OPTIONAL] Fallback user identifier used before Supabase Auth is wired up.
# Safe to pre-fill for local dev; replace with real Supabase Auth values in production.
EXPO_PUBLIC_USER_ID=local-user

# ─── Server-only Secrets (NEVER prefix with EXPO_PUBLIC_) ────────────────────
# [SERVER-ONLY][REQUIRED] Supabase service-role key — has full DB access, bypasses RLS.
# Used exclusively in app/api/secure-proxy+api.ts on the server.
# Find it at https://app.supabase.com → Project Settings → API → service_role secret.
# WARNING: exposing this key client-side is a critical security vulnerability.
SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY=FILL_ME_IN

# [SERVER-ONLY][OPTIONAL] Legacy alias for SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY.
# The secure proxy falls back: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY ?? SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY.
# Only set this if you have existing infrastructure using the old name; prefer the key above.
# SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY=FILL_ME_IN

# ─── Anthropic API Key (offline batch scripts only — not loaded by the app) ───
# [ALREADY_SET] Used by standalone data/analysis scripts, not by the Expo app itself.
# Already configured in the execution environment — do not commit the real value.
ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=FILL_ME_IN

# ─── Clerk Telemetry (optional dev-comfort settings) ─────────────────────────
# [OPTIONAL] Set to 1 to silence Clerk telemetry in CI or local dev.
# CLERK_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1

# [OPTIONAL] Set to 1 to enable verbose Clerk telemetry debug output.
# CLERK_TELEMETRY_DEBUG=0
